scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The core model linking Ki-67, MYBL2/E2F-associated cell-cycle progression, TK1, CDK1, and CKS proteins is biologically coherent. However, it overstates both direct common transcriptional control of broad ribosomal genes and the extent to which Ki-67’s nucleolar role itself explains their co-expression.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response integrates MYBL2/E2F-associated proliferation with TK1-mediated DNA synthesis, CDK1/CKS-associated mitosis, and Ki-67 expression, while also connecting ribosomal genes to a biosynthetic state. The proposed common transcriptional control and the bridge from Ki-67’s nucleolar function to ribosomal-protein co-expression remain insufficiently resolved. No formal synthesis ceiling was applied because a recognizable focus-feature–target mechanism and roles for most invoked features were provided.
